items.html: *And let us now explain the matter of the posteriors of AVI [Aba ve Ima], which also fell and were broken. And first it is necessary to explain the introduction of Panim be Panim [face to face] and Achor be Achor [back to back]. And the matter is that the place of the shells and the externals is the posterior of the Nukva of ZA, and there they cling; and indeed in the posterior of ZA too there is some grip. And behold, before Elokim created man upon the earth, the shells had the power to suck abundance from holiness, in the secret of “and there was no man to work the ground”; and one of the works of the ground is the clearing of thorns from the vineyard, for which practical commandments are needed. But when ZAT were emanated, the lower Adam HaRishon had not yet been created in the world, and ZON emerged Achor be Achor out of fear of the externals, lest they suck. For had they stood Panim be Panim, the shells would have had a place to grip in the place of their grip, which is the posterior, in order to suck — for from the face they could not suck. Therefore they had to adhere Achor be Achor, so that the externals could not suck from there.
